citations.authors: Aschan, C.; Toivonen, M.; Seppälä, T.; Kotiluoto, P.; Auterinen, I.; Serén, T.; Stecher-Rasmussen, F.
citations.title: TL detectors in BNCT dosimetry
citations.venue: IAEA-TECDOC-1223, Current status of neutron capture therapy

provenance.derivation_note: Transverse neutron-fluence-rate profiles (6Li response) digitized from FIG. 4 of Aschan et al., TECDOC-1223 p. 171: MTS-Ns TL detectors (symbols) in the brain-substitute Liquid B phantom (diameter 20 cm, length 24 cm) at 25 mm and 60 mm depths. Pixel extraction from the 200-dpi page render; marker-centroid positions calibrated against printed axis ticks. Phantom composition declared as the brain-tissue-equivalent elemental basis the reference formulation reproduces (ICRU adult brain atomic densities, rho=1.04 g/cm3) — the Liquid B solvent recipe is not published in the TECDOC. Declared 1sigma = 10% of value covering the paper's stated +-0.5 cm spatial uncertainty plus digitization error.

measurements.note: Transverse thermal-fluence-rate scan across the beam axis at 2.5 cm depth in the Liquid B phantom. Points digitized from TECDOC-1223 FIG.4 (TL detectors, symbols); declared 1sigma covers the stated +-0.5 cm spatial uncertainty plus digitization error, folded to ~10% of value.

Transverse thermal-fluence-rate scan across the beam axis at 6 cm depth in the Liquid B phantom. Points digitized from TECDOC-1223 FIG.4 (TL detectors, symbols); declared 1sigma covers the stated +-0.5 cm spatial uncertainty plus digitization error, folded to ~10% of value.
